title: Broken balance update if a slash event happens
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When `_transferToSlashStore()` is called the slash ETH amount is transferred from the native node contract's balance but the code doesn't decrease the value of the `creditedNodeETH` so its value would be higher than it should be and `_startSnapshot()` would revert because of underflow:  ```solidity         // Calculate unattributed node balance         uint256 nodeBalanceWei = node.nodeAddress.balance - node.creditedNodeETH; ```  ## Recommendations  Update the value of the `creditedNodeETH` in `_transferToSlashStore()`.
